notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I have no notes to give you. My first attempt to read the sources hit the tool's usage limit, and after that the tool wouldn't let me make any more calls. I didn't read a single page, including Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), StudyLight, Precept Austin and New Advent.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory and passing them off as sourced would break those rules, so I haven't written any.

**Pages I planned to read:**
- enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-66/
- biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/psalms/66.htm, …/ellicott/psalms/66.htm and …/pulpit/psalms/66.htm (verse pages such as biblehub.com/commentaries/psalms/66-18.htm too)
- preceptaustin.org/psalm-66-commentary
- studylight.org/commentaries/eng/mhm/psalms-66.html (Matthew Henry)
- newadvent.org/fathers/1801066.htm (Augustine on this Psalm)
- netbible.org's notes on Psalm 66, plus searches of spurgeon.org (Treasury of David), desiringgod.org, gty.org, wesley.nnu.edu, 1517.org/lcms.org and gotquestions.org. The aim was to find any real differences between traditions, especially on v. 18 (cherished sin and answered prayer) and vv. 10–12 (God testing his people).

If you ask again in a new message, I'll start with the main verse-by-verse commentaries and then add views from each tradition where the sources support them.
